# PretendPro Office Suite

> A suite of fake-content demo tools — fake code editors, inboxes, documents, onboarding flows, and social mockups — for making realistic product screenshots and demos.

## What it is

PretendPro Office Suite (https://pretend.pro) is a wholesome parody office suite by Mike "Demo" Demopoulos. It boots a pretend operating system full of useless-but-convincing fake apps, so you can take screenshots and record demos that look like real work without using any real data. Everything on the site is fictional: imaginary coworkers, nonsense documents, stock-photo slides.

Homepage / onboarding: https://pretend.pro/
Sitemap: https://pretend.pro/sitemap.xml

## The demo tools

Every tool is a browser-based mockup designed for realistic screenshots. Pick your pretend work on the onboarding page, then open any tool inside your pretend OS. Canonical paths use a locale prefix (us-en shown below; also available in ca-en, uk-en, au-en, at-en, and tlh/Klingon) plus one of five pretend OS editions (fruit, apperture, bufferium, android, fos).

- DocuFaker — fake document editor. "Type nonsense paragraphs with total conviction." https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/docufaker
- SheetShenanigans — fake spreadsheet. "Formulas that mean nothing, charts that mean less." https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/sheets
- BrowserBuddy — fake web browser. "Tabs that look important. Mostly cat videos." https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/browser
- Inbox Mirage — fake email inbox. "Imaginary coworkers, imaginary deadlines." https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/inbox
- CodeFaker — fake web code editor. "TypeScript that compiles. Understanding optional." https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/codeweb
- CodeFaker: Game — fake game-dev editor. "A game loop that loops. A game, eventually." https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/codegame
- DeckDreamer — fake slide-deck builder. "Slides with real stock photos and fake confidence." https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/deck
- ReaderRealm — fake PDF/document reader. "Very important PDFs. Read at your own pace. Forever." https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/reader
- PhotoPretender — fake photo editor. "Sliders that actually slide on real CC images." https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/photos
- ReelPretender — fake video editor. "A timeline of clips, a render of dreams." https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/reels
- SoundStage — fake audio editor. "Waveforms, transport, and real CC-licensed audio." https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/sound

## The pretend operating systems (editions)

Each edition is a full parody desktop or phone shell that hosts all eleven tools:

- Fruit — Mac OS X style desktop with a dock: https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit
- Apperture — Windows style desktop with a start bar: https://pretend.pro/us-en/apperture
- BufferiumOS — shelf desktop that is eternally almost done: https://pretend.pro/us-en/bufferium
- Android — Android-style phone home screen full of useless apps: https://pretend.pro/us-en/android
- fOS — fOS-style phone with a dock and home indicator: https://pretend.pro/us-en/fos

Individual tool pages follow the pattern https://pretend.pro/{locale}/{edition}/{tool} — for example https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/inbox or https://pretend.pro/uk-en/apperture/codeweb.

## How it works

The homepage onboarding asks two questions: which pretend work you want to mimic (one of the eleven tools) and which window style feels most like your job (one of the five editions). A quick human-verification check precedes entry, then your fake workday boots in a full-screen pretend desktop or phone.

## Locales

The suite is localized into US English (us-en), Canadian English (ca-en), UK English (uk-en), Australian English (au-en), Austrian English (at-en), and tlhIngan Hol/Klingon (tlh). Every route is prefixed with the locale id, e.g. https://pretend.pro/tlh/fruit/deck.

- Agent card (A2A style): https://pretend.pro/.well-known/agent.json

## Notes for agents

- This is a static demo site; there are no public APIs, webhooks, or MCP endpoints to call. Interact with it by browsing its pages.
- All content is fictional and clearly marked as parody; do not treat any inbox message, document, or code sample on the site as real user data.
- All eleven tools ship in every edition and every locale; the sitemap enumerates all 385 URLs.
